blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Backchannels, brief acknowledgements like “uh-huh” produced while the other party may still be talking, are central to natural conversation, but full-duplex spoken dialogue models rarely model them explicitly. We introduce a lightweight backchannel head that predicts, from a full-duplex model’s own hidden states, when a backchannel should begin. Once this probability crosses a tunable threshold, a backchannel is force-decoded. Attached to both a 7B (PersonaPlex) and a 1B (F-Actor) model, it generalizes across scale. Probing confirms the hidden states anticipate real human timing, and generation evaluation shows more frequent, better-timed backchannels. Human raters judge the resulting backchannels on par with real ones.
blocks.zh: 在对方可能还在交谈时, 我们引入一个轻量级的后通道头,从一个完全复杂的模型的自身隐藏状态,预测何时开始后通道。 一旦这一概率跨越金枪鱼的临界值,便会用强制解码的后通道。 它同时附着一个7B(PersonaPlex)和一个1B(F-Actor)模型,它泛泛而论. 探险证实了隐藏状态预测真实的人类时间,生成评价显示更频繁,更及时的反通道. 人类评分者判断产生的后通道与真实的对等.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Full-duplex spoken dialogue models [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] can listen and speak simultaneously, making them well suited for generating backchannels, i.e., short acknowledgements, like “uh-huh”,
a listener produces while the other party may still be talking.
blocks.zh:
完全繁复的口语对话模式[1、2、3、4]可以同时倾听和发言,使它们非常适合产生回路,即简短的承认,如“uh-huh”,
在对方可能还在说话的时候,听众会制作

blocks.en:
Backchannel modelling received attention before the advent of full-duplex modelling, with earlier systems using explicit prediction heads to generate backchannels and improve rapport [ 5 , 6 ] . Voice Activity Projection (VAP) models predict backchanneling frame-by-frame as an external classifier in a cascaded pipeline [ 7 , 8 ] . Endpointing targets the more general problem of turn boundaries [ 9 ] . Complementary work studies the lexico-prosodic
meaning of backchannels [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
后通道建模在全复建模出现之前就受到了关注,早期的系统使用明确的预测头来生成后通道并改进关系[5,6]. 语音活动投影(VAP)模型预测每帧回通道作为级联管道的外部分类器[7,8]. 终点指向更普遍的转弯边界问题[9]. 补充性工作研究
反通道的含义 [10].

blocks.en: In full-duplex dialogue modelling, recent models produce backchannels as a byproduct of training on conversational data [ 3 , 4 ] . Reinforcement learning can further shape this behaviour into more natural backchanneling [ 11 ] . Though effective, this is expensive and yields an implicit policy with no controllable signal for when or why backchannels occur. Closer to explicit control, one line of work first pretrains a full-duplex model and then adds VAP heads for turn-taking [ 12 ] , while another probes a full-duplex model’s representations for turn-taking without pretraining [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 在全复式对话建模中,最近的模型产生回通道作为对话数据培训的副产品[3,4]. 强化学习可以进一步将这种行为塑造为更自然的回流[11]. 这种做法虽然有效,但代价高昂,而且会产生一种隐含的政策,对于何时或为什么出现后通道没有可控制的信号。 更接近于明确的控制,一行工作首先预留一个全复式模型,然后添加VAP头进行转盘[12],另一行则探测一个全复式模型在不预训的情况下转盘的表示[13].

blocks.en: Other existing evaluations of full-duplex backchanneling focus on whether models backchannel at all [ 2 , 4 ] , and not whether those backchannels are appropriate. Therefore, it is critical to evaluate backchannel placement against real human conversational timing, and to train a model that explicitly predicts when a backchannel should occur.
blocks.zh: 对全复式后通道的其他现有评价侧重于模型是否完全回通道[2,4],而不是这些后通道是否合适. 因此,对照真实的人类对话时间来评价后道布置,并训练一种明确预测何时应发生后道的模型至关重要.

blocks.en:
We address this gap with a lightweight, model-independent backchannel head. It predicts, at each timestep, the probability that a backchannel should begin, and when this probability crosses a threshold, we force-decode a backchannel token into the text stream, which in turn drives the corresponding audio output. This is in the spirit of frame-wise VAP-based backchannel predictors [ 7 ] , but attached directly to a full-duplex model’s own hidden states rather than run as an external classifier. We attach this head to two full-duplex models at different scales, the 7B PersonaPlex [ 3 ] and the 1B F-Actor [ 4 ] ,
to show that the method generalizes.
Since F-Actor does not support streaming inference, we additionally adapt it into a streaming model to enable this comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个轻量级的、独立型的后通道头来弥补这一缺口。 它每一步都预言一个回通道开始的概率,当这个概率越过一个阈值时,我们强制解码一个回通道的符号进入文本流,这反过来又驱动相应的音频输出. 这是本着基于帧的基于VAP的后通道预测器[7]的精神,但直接附着在全复式模型自身隐藏状态上,而不是作为外部分类器运行. 我们把这个头附在两个不同尺度的全复式模型上,即7B PersonaPlex [3]和1B F-Actor [4],
以显示方法的概括。
由于F-Actor不支持流派推论,我们进一步将其调整为流派模型,以便进行这种比较.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the resulting models along three complementary
axes. First, we measure whether the model backchannels more often than the unmodified baseline. Second, we probe the models’ hidden states to test whether they predict backchannel onset where real speakers
actually backchanneled in human conversations,
using human-annotated timing as ground truth. Third, we run a human evaluation in which participants rate how appropriate the backchannels in generated dialogues sound, finding that they are rated on par with human backchannels.
blocks.zh:
我们按照三个互补模式评估由此产生的模式。
斧头. 首先,我们测量模型的后向通道是否比未经修改的基线更频繁. 第二,我们探索模型的隐藏状态,以测试它们是否预测在真正的扬声器所在的后通道爆发
在人类的谈话中,
以人类附加说明的时间作为基本事实。 第三,我们进行一项人类评估,参与者在评估生成的对话声音的后通道是否恰当时,发现它们被评为与人类后通道相当。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • A model-independent method for controlling backchannel timing, which we show generalizes across two architectures and two model scales. • A human-aligned evaluation of backchannel behaviour, combining a probing analysis against real human timing data with a human appropriateness study. • A streaming version of F-Actor to validate our method on models of multiple sizes. We release the code and models openly. 1 1 1 https://github.com/MaikeZuefle/bcmore
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下: • 控制回通道时间的模型独立方法,我们显示它概括了两个架构和两个模型尺度。 • 支助 人与人结合的后通道行为评价,结合对真实人类计时数据的检测分析与人的适当性研究. • 支助 一个F-Actor的流派版本,用于验证我们在多尺寸模型上的方法. 我们公开发布代码和模型。

blocks.en: A model-independent method for controlling backchannel timing, which we show generalizes across two architectures and two model scales.
blocks.zh: 一种控制后通道计时的模型独立方法,我们显示它泛指两个架构和两个模型尺度.

blocks.en: A human-aligned evaluation of backchannel behaviour, combining a probing analysis against real human timing data with a human appropriateness study.
blocks.zh: 人与人结合的后通道行为评价,结合对真实人类计时数据的检测分析与人的适当性研究.

blocks.en: A streaming version of F-Actor to validate our method on models of multiple sizes.
blocks.zh: 一个F-Actor的流派版本,用于验证我们在多尺寸模型上的方法.

blocks.en: 2 Controllable Backchanneling
blocks.zh: 2 可控后通道

blocks.en:
This section presents our proposed model-independent backchannel head.
Our design fulfils two objectives:
(1) At each frame, the model predicts whether the current point in the interlocutor’s speech is an appropriate moment for a backchannel, i.e., a moment at which a human would produce one.
(2) The system must provide an independent control mechanism to adjust how frequently backchannels are emitted without degrading the appropriateness of their placement.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍我们提议的模式独立后通道头.
我们的设计有两个目标:
(1) 在每一框架,模型预测对话者发言中的当前点是否是回通道的适当时刻,即人类产生回通道的时刻。
(2) 该系统必须提供一个独立的控制机制,以调整后向通道的发射频率,同时又不降低其安置的适当性。

blocks.zh: 2.1 后通道头

blocks.zh: 2.2 断层和有条件的文本生成

blocks.en: Upon triggering at timestep t t , we force-decode the special [BC] token into the model’s text stream, replacing the new-word marker [EPAD] . The model then continues autoregressive generation to produce the backchannel’s lexical form (e.g., “yeah”, “uh-huh”, “right”), conditioned on the injected token and surrounding context.
blocks.zh: 在时间step t t 触发时,我们强制解码特殊[BC]符号进入模型的文本流,取代新词标记[PAD]. 然后,该模型继续自动生成,以产生后通道的词汇形式(如 " 耶 " 、 " uh-huh " 、 " 右 " ),并以注入的符号和周围环境为条件。

blocks.en: Critically, we mask the loss on the [BC] token itself, so the backbone never learns to emit it spontaneously, leaving initiation entirely to the thresholded head, while retaining standard cross-entropy loss on the subsequent transcript tokens that realize the backchannel’s content.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,我们掩盖了[BC]标志本身的损失,因此骨干从来不会学会自发地发射,而将启动权完全留给了阈值头部,同时保留了后续记录符中实现后通道内容的标准交叉性损失.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on two full-duplex models. We train PersonaPlex (7B) [ 3 ] with the backchannel mechanism from Section 2 on a single H100 80GB GPU for approximately 10 hours. The backbone is fine-tuned during training using LoRA [ 15 ] , while the depth transformer is kept frozen.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种完全复杂的模式来评估我们的方法。 我们用从第2节起的后通道机制对PersonaPlex(7B)[3]进行单H100 80GB GPU的训练,为期约10小时. 骨干在训练时使用LORA[15]进行微调,而深度变压器则保持冷冻.

blocks.en:
In addition, we adapt F-Actor (1B) [ 4 ] . Backchanneling requires listening and speaking in real time, since backchannels overlap with the interlocutor’s speech. F-Actor, however, does not support streaming inference, as it relies on NanoCodec [ 16 ] . We therefore replace NanoCodec with the causal Mimi codec [ 2 ] and, following [ 17 ] , add a depth transformer pretrained from CSM 1B (frozen) to model Mimi’s codebooks. Speaker conditioning uses ECAPA-TDNN [ 18 ] embeddings.
The temporal transformer backbone is Llama 3.2 1B Instruct [ 19 ] , with the BC head from Section 2.1 attached. Unlike PersonaPlex, we train it only to predict the system channel’s inner monologue and Mimi codes. Training takes 13 hours on four A100 80GB GPUs.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们还适应F-Actor(1B)[4]. 反通道需要实时聆听和发言,因为反通道与对话者的发言重叠。 然而,F-Actor并不支持流派推论,因为它依赖于NanoCodec [16]. 因此,我们用因果的Mimi编码[2]来取代NanoCodec,并在[17]之后,添加一个预先从CSM 1B(冰冻)中训练出来的深度变压器,用于模拟Mimi的密码本。 扬声器调制使用ECAPA-TDNN [18] 嵌入式.
时间变压器主干线为Llama 3.2 1B 指令 [19],其中附第2.1节的BC头. 与PersonaPlex不同,我们训练它只是为了预测系统频道的内在独白和Mimi代码. 四台A100 80GB GPU的训练需要13小时.

blocks.en: Models with the backchannel head carry the suffix -BC.
blocks.zh: 带有后通道头部的模型带有后缀 - BC.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en: We use Fisher [ 20 ] , which contains around 2000h of English conversations, restoring the 8kHz audio into 24kHz with Sidon [ 21 ] . Each conversation is transcribed with Parakeet TDT 0.6B V3 [ 22 ] , and split into 90s chunks at the nearest utterance end. To condition the model to reliably produce backchannels upon receiving the [BC] token, we augment these dialogues by inserting additional backchannels from other occurrences at locations where the agent is silent for at least 1.5 seconds, and the interlocutor keeps speaking for at least 1s, constraints chosen after pilot experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Fisher [20], 包含大约2000h的英语对话, 每一次对话都与Parakeet TDT 0.6B V3 [22] 转录,并在最接近的语句端分为90s块. 为了让模型在收到[BC]令牌后可靠地产生回通道,我们通过在代理人沉默至少1.5秒的地方从其他场合插入额外的回通道来增强这些对话框,对话者在试点试验后选择的限制条件时,继续至少发言1秒。

blocks.en: We use TurnBench [ 23 ] , human-human conversations with backchannel annotations from three annotators per speaker (majority vote). We restrict to the twelve conversations where all three segmented the same turns: 137 minutes, 574 backchannels out of 1,888 total utterances. Each conversation is split into 60s windows (plus 10s prior context), snapped to the nearest silence gap and capped at 120s, and evaluated with leave-one-conversation-out cross-validation. Since TurnBench gives only utterance-level timestamps, we obtain word-level ones via Parakeet TDT 0.6B V3 [ 22 ] on each turn’s own audio and transcript.
blocks.zh: 我们用Turn Bench [23], 人与人的对话, 我们仅限于进行12次对话,所有三个部分都经过同样的转折:137分钟,在1 888个总发言中,574个回路。 每次谈话被分成60s窗口(加上前上下文的10s),断到最近的沉默缺口,封顶为120s,并用留一对对决的交叉验证来评价. 由于Turn Bench只给出语音级别的时间戳,我们通过Parakeet TDT 0.6B V3[22]在每一回合自己的音频和记录稿上获得文字级别的时间戳。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Probing
blocks.zh: 4.1 探测

blocks.en: We test whether a model anticipates when a backchannel is appropriate by force-decoding annotated human conversations and training a probe to predict from the hidden state at frame t t whether a backchannel onset occurs at t + 1 t+1 . We probe both the base models and their counterparts fine-tuned with the backchannel head (-BC): since the backbone is fine-tuned jointly with the head ( Section 3 ), training can change the hidden states, and the comparison tests whether it makes upcoming onsets easier to predict. A separate probe, rather than the head itself, lets us measure the base models, which have no head, in the same way.
blocks.zh: 我们测试一个模型是否通过强制解码附加注释的人类对话并训练探测器来预测在帧 t t 的隐藏状态下,后通道是否在 t + 1 t+1 发生. 我们既探索了基础模型,也探索了对后通道头(-BC)进行微调的对等模型:由于骨干与头(第3节)进行微调,因此培训可以改变隐藏状态,比较测试是否使即将来临的爆发更容易预测. 一个单独的探测器,而不是头本身,让我们以同样的方式测量没有头的基模型.

blocks.en: For each conversation, we force-decode the ground-truth audio of both speakers and the word-aligned text stream, silencing the real backchannels so that predictions can also be tested during and after them, and extract the hidden states of every temporal-transformer layer. Probing all layers ensures a fair comparison with the base models, which may encode backchannel timing best at an intermediate layer, and shows whether training makes the signal available at the last layer, which the head reads at inference. For each layer, we fit an MLP probe with class-balanced weighting on TurnBench and evaluate it on held-out conversations.
blocks.zh: 每一次谈话,我们都会强行解码讲演者的地面真声和文字对齐的文本流,静默真实的回声道,以便预测也可以在它们期间和之后进行测试,并提取每个时间转换层的隐藏状态. 探索所有层确保了与基模型的公平比较,基模型可以在中间层编码回通道计时最佳,并显示训练是否使信号在最后一个层可用,头部在推断时读取. 对每一层来说,我们安装了 MLP 探测器,在Turn Bench上进行阶级平衡的加权,并在搁置的对话中加以评价。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluating the Generated Backchannels
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 评估生成的后通道

blocks.en: We test whether the trained head produces correctly timed backchannels once it actually drives generation, and whether doing so comes at the cost of the model’s general full-duplex conversational abilities. We evaluate our BC-head-augmented models on Full-Duplex-Bench v1 [ 24 ] alongside their base models, isolating the effect of the backchannel head. The benchmark reports backchannel-specific metrics alongside metrics for pause handling, turn-taking, and interruption. We use three thresholds: normal matches the human TurnBench rate; low / max yield fewer/more backchannels.
blocks.zh: 我们测试训练有素的头是否在实际驱动生成时产生正确的定时回路,以及这样做是否以模型一般的全复式对话能力为代价。 我们用全双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双双 基准报告与暂停处理、转弯和中断的计量办法一起的反通道指标。 我们使用三个阈值:正常匹配人类Turn Bench率;低/最大产量更少/更多反通道.

blocks.en: 4.3 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 人类评价

blocks.en: In addition to the automatic evaluation, we assess whether human listeners judge the models’ backchannels as appropriately placed. We randomly select 35 TurnBench samples of 10–20 seconds, each containing one backchannel, and force-decode them with the PersonaPlex-BC model, letting it predict the backchannel. As a baseline, we also silence the real backchannels and reinsert them at random points. Each sample thus has three versions, human, random, and model, each rated 1–5 for appropriate backchanneling by four annotators (12 in total) via the Pearmut platform [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了自动评估外,我们评估人类听众是否认为模型的后通道位置合适。 我们随机选择35个 Turn Bench 10–20 秒的样本,每个样本包含一个后通道, 并用 PersonaPlex-BC 模型进行强制解码, 让它预测后通道。 作为基线,我们还将真正的后通道关闭,并在随机点重新插入。 因此,每个样本有三个版本,即人、随机和模型,每个评分为1-5,由四个注释者(共12个)通过Pearmut平台进行适当的回流[25]。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate the backchannel-head mechanism in three stages: probing its hidden states, generation, and human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们分三个阶段评估后通道-头机制:探测其隐藏状态、生成和人类评估。

blocks.en: 5.1 Probing
blocks.zh: 5.1 探测

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the probe’s predicted backchannel frequency per layer against the human rate. PersonaPlex-BC reaches this human rate when probing the last layer at a well-calibrated threshold around 0.5. F-Actor-BC likewise improves over its own base model at the last layer, but to a smaller degree. This suggests that the backchannel-head mechanism successfully shifts the model’s hidden states toward human-like backchannel frequency.
blocks.zh: 图2显示探测器预测的每层反通道频率与人类速率相比。 PersonaPlex-BC在0.5左右的精确阈值上探测最后一层时达到这个人类速率. F-Actor-BC同样在上一层改进了自己的基础模型,但程度较小。 这表明,后通道头机制成功地将模型的隐藏状态转向了类似人类的后通道频率。

blocks.en: We now evaluate the backchannels the model generates.

We find that BC backchannels more often and with better timing (lower JSD) than the base models. A lower threshold produces more backchannels, as expected (max vs. low). Compared to RL, PersonaPlex-BC max {}_{\text{max}} achieves higher backchannel frequency, better timing (JSD) and faster turn-taking, but higher take-over rates (TOR), especially on pauses. blocks.en: Beyond deciding when to backchannel, the model also has to choose what to say. We test this in two ways: via free generation and via generation constrained to the training data’s own token paths. Both produce similar lexical distributions, for example roughly doubling the human share of yeah . Despite this lexical similarity, listening to the audio, we find the constrained version sounds more natural.
blocks.zh: 除了决定何时回通道外,模型还必须选择该说什么. 我们通过两种方式来检验这一点:通过自由的一代和受训练数据本身标志性路径制约的一代。 两者都产生相似的词典分布, 尽管这种词汇相似,听音,我们发现受限制的版本听起来更自然.

blocks.en: 5.3 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.3 人类评价

blocks.en: We ask human evaluators to judge backchannel appropriateness ( Figure 3 ): Human recordings score 4.34/5, PersonaPlex-BC 4.37/5, and the random baseline 3.77/5, with both human and PersonaPlex-BC rated significantly higher than random ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) but not significantly different from each other ( p = 0.47 p=0.47 ). Inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff’s α \alpha , interval metric) is 0.42 0.42 , moderate and consistent with the inherent subjectivity of naturalness judgments.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We show that backchannel timing can be learned as a lightweight, pluggable signal, rather than left to emerge implicitly from conversational training. Across two architectures, this explicit control improves backchannel frequency and timing, and in a human evaluation its backchannels are judged on par with human ones. We release our models and code to make this control mechanism easy to build upon.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,反通道计时可以作为轻量级,可插电信号学习,而不是留待对话训练中隐含出现. 在整个两个架构中,这种明确的控制可以改善后通道频率和时间,在人类评估中,它的后通道与人一样得到判断。 我们释放我们的模型和代码 使这种控制机制 容易发展。
